text:
erin: heads-up  customers reporting unexpected org-level billing after yesterday's routing change. small percentage but concentrated on few tenants.

matt: do we have a quick signal showing where attribution is lost? edge, auth exchange, or model pool?

erin: traced a handful  incoming header has project, exchanged token from auth-service sometimes only carries org. looks like an exchange-time decision.

zoe: that's the new compat-exchange path, right? we added a handshake to ensure older model backends accept tokens. it has logic to drop project claim for compatibility.

ravi: dropping was deliberate historically, but we never exposed that behavior in console or telemetry. customers see quota jump with no trace.

matt: short fix: emit a telemetry tag `auth.exchange_preserved` and `routing.fallback_used` so we can surface it in the quota UI. then decide whether to change behavior.

erin: +1. also want a per-request small flag in traces so product teams can see if a particular call used compat-exchange.

zoe: implementation note: modify auth-service to attach `exchange_preserved=true/false` to trace span and to the request event. cheap change, low risk.

ravi: UX ask: console should show "Billing attributed to org because request used compat-exchange" with a link to opt into strict project routing. We'll need a short help doc describing the tradeoffs.

matt: rollout plan idea: 1) add telemetry immediately (global) 2) enable `auth.preserve_claims=true` behind a canary flag on auth for internal orgs 3) measure model rejection rate and latency delta 4) if safe, phased enable for customers.

erin: how do we detect model rejection quickly? auth logs a 409 when model rejects project-scoped token. can we surface a metric `model_reject_rate` and alert if >0.5%?

zoe: yes. will add a dashboard panel and set a low-severity alert for the canary. also log truncated original headers (scrubbed) for 48h to help root cause. legal approved TTL+scrub.

ravi: important: we must preserve opt-out. add `auth.force_strip=true` that tenant admins can toggle if they rely on org attribution.

matt: ops: pager-bot schedule canary toggle?

pager-bot: scheduled canary at 1801234700 for orgs [redwood-int-ops, redwood-int-test]. flag `auth.preserve_claims=true` applied to auth-canary. monitoring `auth.exchange_preserved` and `model_reject_rate`.

erin: owners: zoe telemetry + dashboard, matt ops/canary, ravi console copy + docs. check-in in 6h with first canary numbers.

matt: one more ask  include `routing.fallback_variant` enum in the telemetry (`compat`, `cost-optimized`, `regional`) so we can correlate cost/latency.

zoe: added to the telemetry plan. will push instrumentation this morning.

erin: thanks all  if we see model rejects spike we revert preserve_claims for canary. otherwise we'll prepare rollout notes for customers.
